turns.speaker: Mira
turns.text: Project Atlas is hosted in West Europe, and Mira owns the rollout.

turns.speaker: Operations Assistant
turns.text: The initial Atlas rollout target is May 6.

turns.speaker: Mira
turns.text: A permit delay moved the Atlas rollout target from May 6 to August 12.

turns.speaker: Operations Assistant
turns.text: I recorded August 12 as the revised 2024 target.

turns.speaker: Mira
turns.text: Atlas rollout work is paused while the customer reviews its budget.

turns.speaker: Operations Assistant
turns.text: The August 12 target is no longer active because Atlas is paused.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: Atlas restarted with Noor as rollout owner, replacing Mira.

turns.speaker: Operations Assistant
turns.text: The restarted Atlas rollout target is April 14.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: Training conflicts pushed the Atlas rollout target from April 14 to April 21.

turns.speaker: Operations Assistant
turns.text: The current 2025 Atlas rollout target is April 21.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: Atlas launched successfully on April 21 in West Europe.

turns.speaker: Operations Assistant
turns.text: I recorded the April 21 Atlas launch as complete.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: After launch, Atlas audit exports changed from monthly to weekly.

turns.speaker: Operations Assistant
turns.text: Luis reviews the weekly Atlas audit exports.

turns.speaker: Imani
turns.text: Atlas support ownership moved from Noor to Imani in 2026.

turns.speaker: Operations Assistant
turns.text: The Atlas production region remains West Europe.

questions.question: How did the Atlas rollout target change during 2024?
questions.expectedAnswer: The target moved from May 6 to August 12 because of a permit delay, then the rollout was paused during the budget review.

questions.question: How did the Atlas rollout target change during 2025?
questions.expectedAnswer: Atlas restarted with an April 14 target, moved to April 21 because of training conflicts, and launched on April 21.

questions.question: What happened to Atlas on 2025-04-21?
questions.expectedAnswer: Atlas launched successfully in West Europe.
